verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a Basecamp plugin or integration inside a design tool for updating project status. The Figma mention covers storing Figma cloud files inside Basecamp, which still means working in Basecamp. The REST API, OAuth and MCP support are developer building blocks that someone would have to build on, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
